links.outcome: Group-conditional conformal coverage across gender and age subgroups on external cohort
links.effect: Mondrian conformal ensured group-conditional coverage >= 89.6% across gender and age subgroups.
links.quote: Mondrian conformal ensured group-conditional coverage >= 89.6% across gender and age subgroups.

links.outcome: Coverage change between development hospital and external hospital under distribution shift
links.effect: Marginal conformal gave 92.1% external coverage but only 31.3% for AKI-positive patients; class-conditional raised AKI coverage to 87.2%, still below the 90% target, indicating within-class shift.
links.quote: Empirically, class-conditional conformal prediction raised AKI coverage to 87.2% (95% CI: 86.6%-89.8%); by our result the gap below 90% quantifies within-class shift between the two hospitals.

unlisted_practices: Conformal prediction with distribution-free coverage guarantees for predictive model uncertainty

screen.reason: Evaluates conformal prediction methods (marginal, class-conditional, Mondrian) as an uncertainty quantification safeguard to guarantee coverage and handle distribution shift across clinical sites.
